job_spec.purpose: hfd_stn_r38 relay on its BUDGET SHEET (r22/r23 hfd_stn_r38: a input min-delay FF 42 / b output 5.2, internal 442/501 ps) via route_view.sh: the station margin recipe guessed the FF insertion and the CTS-only run hit RSZ-0060 twice (512 input hold endpoints, 2,628 buffers)
